content.short: DAOhaus lets communities create a DAO and manage, grow, and distribute a shared treasury.
content.description: DAOhaus enables the formation of DAOs using Moloch v3 smart contracts. With Moloch DAOs, members can securely pool funds in safes and govern decisions through proposals. All core governance actions are executed on-chain, providing transparent, auditable processes for investors, developers, or friends coordinating in the web3 space. DAOhaus supports deployments on Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, and Multichain, delivering a practical, trust-minimized framework for collective decision-making and fund management.
